maddeler.e: مُطَلْسَم • (muṭalsam) (feminine مُطَلْسَمَة (muṭalsama), masculine plural مُطَلْسَمُون (muṭalsamūn), feminine plural مُطَلْسَمَات (muṭalsamāt))
maddeler.t: Derived from the passive participle of طَلْسَمَ (ṭalsama, “to charm with a talisman”), from a root ط ل س م (ṭ l s m) extracted from طِلَسْم (ṭilasm, “talisman”).
s: ط ل س م (ṭ l s m)
